<solar/>Ignition Kills grant Grenade Energy based on the <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] /> of the killed targets:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 8%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 12.25%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 16.5%
• Players: 20.75%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 25%
